_about: Every number here is a typical estimate, to be verified against real quotes. Replace source and sourceNote once a real, dated source is checked. Each event type's budget shares add up to exactly 100% (the emergency buffer is fixed at the engine's 10%, and the other categories were proportionally rescaled to the remaining 90%, with any rounding remainder put on the largest category). The budget engine still normalises weights as a safety net.
